collision_boundary.C194: C194 owns Holte carries and the base/riffle semigroup; C301 refines labelled set partitions by independent bit words and studies absorption at label separation.
collision_boundary.C215: C215 owns continuous-time Kingman coalescence; C301 moves in the reverse refinement direction with synchronous discrete updates.
collision_boundary.C276: C276 owns one marked orbit in a uniform random mapping; C301 separates all labels and has a logarithmic last-collision threshold.
collision_boundary.integer_partition_warning: quotienting to unlabelled block-size partitions changes state multiplicities and is outside the theorem.

model.one_step_kernel: K_n(pi,sigma)=2^(|pi|-n) exactly when sigma refines pi and each pi-block contains at most two sigma-blocks; otherwise 0
model.t_step_kernel: K_n^t(pi,sigma)=1_{sigma refines pi} product_{B in pi} (2^t)_{r_B}/(2^t)^{|B|}
model.update: each label independently receives a fresh fair bit; every block is refined by its two bit fibres and empty fibres are deleted

nonclaims: No target arithmetic local datum, Euler factor, root number, automorphy, divisor law, functional equation, zero match, or Hilbert--Polya operator is asserted.
The finite-state Markov determinant is source-local and is not identified with an arithmetic zeta or L-function.
No literature-priority claim is made for fragmentation chains, occupancy laws, birthday asymptotics, or Hopf-algebraic Markov chains.

proof_certificates.kernel_count: for r target fibres in a source block, injective word assignments number (2^t)_r
proof_certificates.semigroup_word: after t rounds, each label carries an independent uniform word in {0,1}^t; blocks are equal-word fibres inside starting blocks
proof_certificates.spectrum_guard: rank ordering makes K block upper triangular with scalar diagonal 2^{k-n}I on rank k; recursive block elimination gives the squarefree annihilator, not diagonal entries alone

route_a.obstruction: absorbing refinement has no nonconstant recurrent primitive cycles, and its finite Markov determinant supplies no arithmetic local datum, logarithmic prime clock, target completed determinant, divisor law, or self-adjoint target-zero lift

theorem.absorption_mass: P(T_n=t)=P(T_n<=t)-P(T_n<=t-1), with the t=-1 CDF set to 0
theorem.critical_limit: if n_j tends to infinity and n_j^2/2^{t_j} tends to lambda in (0,infinity), then P(T_{n_j}<=t_j) tends to exp(-lambda/2)
theorem.diagonalizability: product_{k=1}^n(K_n-2^{k-n}I)=0, hence K_n is diagonalizable over Q
theorem.lattice_boundary: a phase-free continuous limit for T_n-2 log_2 n is not asserted because integer t and dyadic scaling retain subsequence phase

title: Parallel binary refinement of labelled set partitions
